financial.title: The Policy-Rate Signal Test
financial.question: Does the Norwegian policy-rate signal improve next-month EUR/NOK changes relative to a random-walk baseline?
financial.limits: Monthly Norges Bank middle rates are indicative, not executable returns. The model omits foreign rates, risk appetite, energy prices and intervention expectations. The 72-month evaluation is latest-vintage and repeatedly re-estimated; it is not a trading strategy and includes no transaction costs.

accounting.title: The Working-Capital Warning Test
accounting.question: Does prior working-capital absorption improve next-year operating cash-flow margin forecasts beyond persistence?
accounting.limits: Six technology issuers are not a representative economy-wide panel. Company Facts tags, fiscal calendars and restatements differ. Working-capital absorption covers receivables, inventory and current payables only; it excludes deferred revenue, contract assets and other accruals. Latest-vintage SEC facts are not an archived real-time backtest.
